finalText:
**Build passes clean now, exit 0.**

Two real bugs, not noise, were hiding behind the deprecation spam:

- `[src/core/options.js:7](src/core/options.js:7)` read `options.retries`, but the bumped bundler now passes `retryCount`. Threw on `undefined.toFixed()`.
- `[src/net/retryPolicy.js:8](src/net/retryPolicy.js:8)` threw when `backoffEnabled` was `undefined`, since the new config loader stopped defaulting unset flags to `false`.

Fixed both: read `retryCount`, and treat `undefined` as disabled.

Next: nothing, build finishes with `8 warnings, 0 errors`, rest is deprecation noise.
